postHarvestCuring.method: Cool to 32–36°F within 24 hr; stage in cold room before long-term storage

orchardSeasonalTasks.title: Dormant oil spray window
orchardSeasonalTasks.body: Apply horticultural oil before bud-break to smother overwintering scale + mites. Temp ≥ 40°F for 24 h after spray.

orchardSeasonalTasks.title: Pre-bloom fungicide (silver-tip → green-tip)
orchardSeasonalTasks.body: Scab + powdery mildew protectant. Captan / sulfur per label.

orchardSeasonalTasks.title: Bloom fungicide (pink → petal-fall)
orchardSeasonalTasks.body: Critical scab + fire blight window. NO insecticides during open bloom — protect pollinators.

orchardSeasonalTasks.title: Hand or chemical fruit thinning
orchardSeasonalTasks.body: Thin to one fruit per cluster at 10–15 mm fruit size for size + return-bloom.

orchardSeasonalTasks.title: Summer cover spray (codling moth + apple maggot)
orchardSeasonalTasks.body: Pheromone trap counts drive timing. Avoid pollinator activity — spray after sunset.

orchardSeasonalTasks.title: Pre-harvest cover spray (sooty blotch / flyspeck)
orchardSeasonalTasks.body: Final fungicide pass; respect the 14-day pre-harvest interval per product.

orchardSeasonalTasks.title: Apple harvest window
orchardSeasonalTasks.body: Pick to color + brix indicators (above). Cool within 24 h.

notes: Perennial. Treat orchard boundary as a no-spray buffer for residual corn/pumpkin herbicides.
